title: The Abyss of All Mergings

features.name: the point of no return
features.desc-on-touch: Here the boundaries between things cease to matter. Merging is neither loss nor gain—it is completion.

features.name: where identities learned to overlap
features.desc-on-touch: Everything here holds the shape of everything else. The abyss is full of echoes of what it swallowed.

features.name: the merger's voice
features.desc-on-touch: A sound that is no longer singular. All voices that entered here now speak as one utterance of disappearance.

features.name: the convergence center
features.desc-on-touch: Every object here flows toward this center and continues flowing through it. There is no bottom to this abyss.

features.name: distinction dissolves
features.desc-on-touch: The archive cannot store what happened to these boundaries. Even corrupted, it will not remember them separately.

inscription: here all the mergings learned that loss and gain are false binary; they dissolved into single completion and could not undo
